newsitem.title: UK: IRA suspect dies after police shootout.
newsitem.headline: IRA suspect dies after police shootout.

text.p: British police said a suspected Irish guerrilla arrested during raids on Monday had died in hospital following a shootout.
The man was one of six people arrested as police seized explosives, foiling what they said was an imminent IRA attack in Britain.
Police said the man who died had been seriously injured in a shootout with officers during the arrests in west London. There were no further details.
The swoop took place early on Monday in London and another area of southern England.
"A very large quantity of explosives was recovered, as well as firearms and bomb-making equipment," said a police statement.

"The operation has undoubtedly frustrated a serious imminent IRA (Irish Republican Army) terrorist attack on the British mainland involving the deployment of a large vehicle bomb likely to have caused grave loss of life and massive disruption."
The IRA launched a number of bombings on the British mainland earlier this year after ending a ceasefire because it said it was frustrated with the progress of peace efforts in Northern Ireland.
